Thanks for this, and for the detailed write-up with the real Nova deltas! I've continued it in #6229, which includes your commits. It also handles Bedrock's `reasoningContent` (Claude, Nova 2) and moves the tag parsing into a helper shared with `NvidiaLLMService`, and it handles Nova responses with several thinking blocks between tool calls. Closing this in favor of #6229. Feel free to review there.
